---
title: "Cloud storage"
---

The project data and models are versioned with [DVC](dev/dvc.qmd) on MinIO.
The project used to store them on [The Good Cloud](https://deltares.thegood.cloud/), and the class `ribasim_nl.CloudStorage` still has that name, see the [API reference](reference/CloudStorage.qmd).

## Paths

Most code uses `CloudStorage` to find local paths under `RIBASIM_NL_DATA_DIR`:

```python
from ribasim_nl import CloudStorage

cloud = CloudStorage()

verwerkt = cloud.joinpath("Delfland", "verwerkt")
model_dir = cloud.model_dir("Delfland", "forcing")
```

## The Good Cloud

::: {.callout-warning}
The rest of this page is about the legacy storage. It is not the main storage method for current workflows: use MinIO through [DVC](dev/dvc.qmd) instead, with the credentials of the [developer setup](dev/index.qmd#sec-environment-variables).
:::

The Good Cloud needs the password `RIBASIM_NL_CLOUD_PASS` in `.env`, which is only shared among project collaborators, since not all input data is public.

The output models, both nationwide (folder Rijkswaterstaat) and per water board, are public.
These are the share links of the models. Sort on "Modified" to find the latest versions. Models only get here by hand, with `notebooks/uploaden_modellen.py`, so they may be older than the [model viewer](viewer.qmd).

The pipeline still has one use for it: if `data/Basisgegevens/GKW` is not local, which is not versioned with DVC, the `parameterized` stages of 9 water authorities download it from there, see `ribasim_nl.gkw`.

```python
# what is available
cloud.source_data
cloud.water_authorities

# download national data
cloud.download_basisgegevens(bronnen=["PBL_watertypenkaart"])

# download the data of a water authority: delivered, processed, or both
cloud.download_aangeleverd("Rijkswaterstaat")
cloud.download_verwerkt("Rijkswaterstaat")
cloud.download_all("Rijkswaterstaat")

# upload processed data
cloud.upload_verwerkt("Rijkswaterstaat", overwrite=True)

# see which models have been uploaded, and upload a new version of the `ijsselmeer` model
cloud.uploaded_models("Rijkswaterstaat")
cloud.upload_model("Rijkswaterstaat", model="ijsselmeer")
```
